title: Underlying simplicial-set homotopy equivalences induce abelian homology isomorphisms
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof cannot assume the homotopy inverse is additive; it passes to free simplicial abelian groups and constructs normalized cycle lifts to prove both surjectivity and injectivity. This bridge from set-level to additive homotopy is a nonformal derived-homological argument.
